description: Skelet AF-14c: tighten find_similar candidate gate to the AF-SEC-00 predicate (security fix with regressions)

compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: skelet.agent.v1 envelope unchanged, no new tools/routes, no migration, search path untouched, previously passing suites still green? Any changed ranking or behavior beyond denying rows the central gate already denies?

Do the 2 new regression tests prove the orphan is invisible as candidate and denied as reference on both layers and transports, and does the pre-existing workspace-private suite still pass?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: leak reproduced failing before the fix and green after, db similarity 11/11, transport similar 5/5, assets 27/27, web 125/125, python 217/217, lint/typecheck clean, graft green? Any claim without execution?

reliability.instructions: Any nondeterminism or resource risk: predicate change is a pure WHERE-clause restriction (fewer rows, same stable id order, same cap), no new queries, no timeouts needed?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the gate fix: kinds expansion, embeddings, new tools, search changes, gate redesign (workspace-public narrowing left exactly as the qualified search path has it), or unrelated refactors?

security.instructions: Does the fix close the leak completely: global-private non-registry titles/metadata unreachable as candidates and as references for every actor on both transports, pre-existing private-workspace and oracle tests still green, error bodies static, direction strictly fail-closed (narrowing only)?
